comment: This class is really boring, but not difficult. If you want an easy FYS, take "Seeing, Believing, and Understanding". There is one homework assignment every week and a half and they don't take super long. Class is lecture, but no one pays attention. The midterm isn't super difficult.
If he's teaching a first year seminar run for the hills. So easy to tune out until it's time for a midterm exam and you've learned absolutely nothing .

This class is so boring that I'm actually typing a review in it right now. If you want a class where you can learn nothing and still pass then this class is perfect for you. Many of my peer as of this moment are on their phones not paying attention to the lecture. The teacher himself is actually on his phone. I have no Idea what we're learning rn.
